name: Wonderfold Wagon W4 (and W2 Elite/Luxe)

clekListed.clekRow: Wonderfold Wagon | W4 and W2 Elite/Luxe | Clek Car Seat Adapter

specs._weightNote: 55 lb (25 kg) with seats installed per Wonderfold DTC (some retailer listings cite ~51 lb).
specs._dimsNote: W4 open ~49 L x 29 W; height 34–41.5 in at handlebar (51.5 in to top of canopy). Folds flat to ~18.5 L x 29 W x 42 H and self-stands. Interior cabin ~33 L x 21 W x 19 D.

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: seated riders 6+ months (sit unassisted); newborns from birth via a Clek infant seat on the Clek Car Seat Adapter

specs._capacityNote: W4 total wagon capacity 300 lb (136 kg); up to 99 lb (45 kg) per bench/seat. seatCount 4 reflects the primary-spec W4 (quad). W2 Elite/Luxe is the 2-seat sibling on the same Clek row.

safety.certifications: Not separately published on the sources reviewed.
safety.notes: 5-point harnesses with pads on each raised bench seat; all-terrain wheels with suspension and bearings.

recall.source: CPSC/SaferProducts search — no Wonderfold W4/W2 wagon recall found

specs.foldType: one-step compact fold, self-standing when folded
specs.recline: removable raised bench seats that recline
specs.tires: all-terrain wheels with suspension and bearings

notes: On Clek's official Liing/Liingo list as 'W4 and W2 Elite/Luxe' using the Wonderfold 'Clek Car Seat Adapter' (adapter-wonderfold-clek, no part # on Clek's list). PRIMARY specs above are the W4 (quad, 4 seats, 300 lb / 99 lb-per-bench, ~55 lb, open ~49 x 29 in). The W2 Elite/Luxe is the smaller 2-seat sibling on the same row: seats 2 children, narrower/shorter frame and lower total capacity — verify W2-specific dims separately if needed. Adapter fitment differs by model: up to TWO Clek adapters may be installed on W4 Elite/Luxe, but only ONE on W2. Best in-stock price $599 (Dillard's); Wonderfold DTC also $599 but currently sold out. Basket capacity and some cert numbers not published on pages reviewed — left null rather than guessed.
